sentences.text: Judinornis was a prehistoric flightless bird belonging to the Hesperornithes, a group of toothed seabirds from the Cretaceous.
This animal is classified within the family Baptornithidae.
The genus Judinornis was described by Nessov and Borkin in 1983, with the only known species being Judinornis nogontsavensis.
Fossils of this species have been found in the Nemegt Formation of southern Mongolia, dating to the Maastrichtian stage between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
Unlike its relatives, Judinornis apparently inhabited estuaries and rivers flowing from the mountains of East Asia toward the Turgai Sea and the former Shigatze Ocean.
